Hosting and servers in Uzbekistan

Citizens' data stays in Uzbekistan as the law requires, and your sites and apps open fast for local users. An MVP in 1–3 weeks, from UZS 6 mln; the full version in 3–6 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

Timeline and price

Timeline
MVP 1–3 weeksFull 3–6 weeks
Price
MVP UZS 6–24.5 mln $500–2,000Full UZS 36–97 mln $3,000–8,000Rate: Central Bank of Uzbekistan, 21.10.2026, $1 = UZS 12,012
Per month
UZS 0.6–18.5 mln your own running costs: hosting, SMS and other services
Difficulty
simple
Who it is for
Any business, Banks, Clinics, E-commerce, Public sector, Education centres and schools

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Choice of a local data centre or cloud
  • Server setup
  • Domain, SSL and firewall
  • Deployment of your app
  • Basic monitoring
What the full version adds
  • High-availability setup across two locations
  • CDN for static files
  • Backups
  • Central logs
  • A written runbook
  • Handover or ongoing management
Please note

Hosting set-up is inside the price of every new build; quote it on its own only to move existing systems or data to Uzbekistan.

What we need from you

  • Access to servers and accounts
  • A description of the current system
  • A technical contact

What raises the price

High load
price +25 %, timeline +15 %
Moving old data

Questions

What does “Hosting and servers in Uzbekistan” cost?
The MVP costs $500–2,000 (UZS 6–24.5 mln), the full version $3,000–8,000 (UZS 36–97 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Hosting and servers in Uzbekistan” take?
The MVP takes 1–3 weeks, the full version 3–6 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Access to servers and accounts; A description of the current system; A technical contact.
